title: Compose Cremona transformations on divisor-class data

source.citation: Luís Gustavo Mendes and Liliana Puchuri, Negative Curves and Elliptic Fibrations on a Special Rational Surface, arXiv:2409.19235

translation.notes: The three mutable Python functions in the paper are encoded as exact integer matrices on `(degree,m1,m_tau,m_tau2,m_infinity)`. Their published word sends `[6,3,1,1,1]` to `[45,19,12,13,1]`, and each transformation is certified involutive.
